usages.explain: Used after intentional verbs to express a sense of apprehension that "such an action will happen regardless of one's desire". It is often used to talk about the speaker's own actions.

examples.content: この本は面白いから全部読んでしまいそうだ。
examples.transcription: このほんはおもしろいからぜんぶよんでしまいそうだ。
examples.mean: This book is so interesting that I want to read it all.

examples.content: 1度やめていたお酒をまた飲んでしまいそうだ。
examples.transcription: 1どやめていたおさけをまたのんでしまいそうだ。
examples.mean: I feel like I'm going to start drinking again after I stopped drinking.

title: しまいそうだ => It seems like this is about to happen
